i0: Many nouns are followed by a **fixed preposition**: *the **reason for** the delay, the **cause of** the fire, a **solution to** the problem*. Learn the noun and its preposition **together**.
i1: There are also fixed **preposition + noun** phrases: *on purpose, by mistake, in advance*. For prepositions after verbs and adjectives, see [Verbs and Prepositions](/blog/grammar/verbs-and-prepositions/) and [Adjectives and Prepositions](/blog/grammar/adjectives-and-prepositions/).
np-common.t: The reason for, a solution to, a problem with
np-common.s: Common pairs: **reason for**, **cause of**, **solution / answer / key to**, **invitation to**, **increase / rise in**, **demand / need for**, **problem with**, **relationship with**, **difference between**, **interest in**, **damage to**, **effect on**.
np-common.b0.2.1: solution, answer, key, invitation, damage, reply
np-common.b1: The noun often has a different preposition from its verb: *They **solved** the problem* (no preposition) / *a **solution to** the problem*.
np-prep-noun.t: On purpose, by mistake, in advance, on holiday
np-prep-noun.s: Fixed **preposition + noun** phrases: **on purpose**, **by mistake / accident / chance**, **in advance**, **in a hurry**, **on holiday / business**, **for sale**, **on sale**, **in danger**, **at risk**, **out of order**, **out of date**, **in charge of**.
np-prep-noun.b0.0.1: on purpose, on holiday, on business, on sale, on fire, on foot
np-prep-noun.b0.1.1: by mistake, by accident, by chance, by car, by hand
np-prep-noun.b0.2.1: in advance, in a hurry, in danger, in love, in charge of, in tears
np-prep-noun.b0.3.1: at risk, at first, at least, at the moment
np-prep-noun.b0.4.1: out of order, out of date, out of work, out of stock
np-prep-noun.b0.5.1: for sale, for rent, for a change
np-prep-noun.b1: ***For sale*** = someone wants to sell it. ***On sale*** = available in shops, or (especially in AmE) at a lower price.
